name: Bollywood Romance
description: Larger-than-life romance, exotic locales, and dramatic sacrifices.

chapters.title: The Meet Cute
chapters.description: A spectacular, coincidental meeting in a picturesque location.

chapters.title: The Antagonism
chapters.description: Initial friction; they hate each other (but the chemistry is obvious).

chapters.title: The Journey Together
chapters.description: A road trip or forced proximity that forces them to rely on each other.

chapters.title: The Realization (The Song Sequence)
chapters.description: One (or both) realizes they are in love, usually during a festival or rain.

chapters.title: The Obstacle
chapters.description: Class difference, a strict father, or a pre-arranged engagement.

chapters.title: The Heartbreak
chapters.description: A misunderstanding or forced sacrifice drives them apart.

chapters.title: The Painful Separation
chapters.description: Longing from afar; moving on but unable to forget.

chapters.title: The Truth Revealed
chapters.description: Discovering why the separation really happened.

chapters.title: The Climax at the Airport/Wedding
chapters.description: A desperate race against time to stop a wedding or a flight.

chapters.title: The Parent's Blessing
chapters.description: Winning over the strict patriarch through a grand gesture.

chapters.title: The happily Ever After
chapters.description: A joyous celebration, dancing into the sunset.
